AA48

- Growing in small group along soil bank near walking trail in well-shaded mixed oak/hickory woodland, near creek.
- Gills attached with decurrent tooth.

- Smell: farinaceous.
- Taste: bitter and farinaceous
- Ultra Violet: negative
